name: What makes metal roofing a weather-resistant option for homes in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: What makes metal roofing a weather-resistant option for homes in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofing offers superior weather resistance due to its interlocking panel systems and durable materials like steel or aluminum. These features help it withstand high winds, hail, and heavy rain, which are common in the DFW area. The smooth, hard surface of metal roofs also resists moss and mildew growth. When considering options, evaluate the gauge and coating of the metal, as these factors significantly impact its long-term performance against extreme weather.
